scope: Renderer-independent production logic and local asset integrity; browser appearance, input, and audible output require root CUA review.

checks.name: Safe light/gate route reaches rescue and powered handover
Leaving corridor open causes generator failure before handover
Protecting generator without guiding worker fails at high tide
Closing a gate after an intruder already crossed cannot trap him behind it
Floodlight delays approach by a finite interval
Beacon only operates at lighthouse and consumes exact activation power
Backup power is available only at archives and once per shift
Loss of power disables floodlights, beacon and held shutter
Corrupt saves cannot create NaN, invalid camera or out-of-range power
Completed episodes stop consuming power and time
Stateful actions are disabled after failure, camera review remains possible
All six authored runtime files and generation originals exist
